name: companion
description: Use when a live companion screen should ask the user one question with two to four clickable option cards and send their selection back to the agent.

question.description: The question as an h2 with id q-question. The companion fills it from screen.json.

options.description: The option cards inside the element that carries data-quirk-nonce. The companion fills it from screen.json.

content.description: Optional freeform HTML shown above the options: a mockup, a comparison, notes or a diagram.
